description: Optional public ingress for `pnpm kyberion ingress up --surface <id>`: exposes one opted-in loopback surface (e.g. event-intake for GitHub webhooks) at a public HTTPS URL through a provider declared in public-ingress-providers.json. Readiness and setup steps come from the provider resolver.

capabilities.description: A live public-ingress provider is ready on this host (default: Tailscale Funnel — client installed and logged in, HTTPS certificates enabled, funnel node attribute granted).

install.instruction: Tailscale Funnel: (1) install Tailscale (`brew install --cask tailscale-app` on macOS) and enable its CLI (menu > Settings > Install CLI, or set KYBERION_TAILSCALE_BIN); (2) log in; (3) in the tailnet admin console enable MagicDNS + HTTPS Certificates (DNS page) and grant the `funnel` node attribute (Access controls); (4) run `pnpm kyberion ingress probe`. See knowledge/public/procedures/expose-surface-public-ingress.md.
